name: Jerusalem Marthoma Church, Nallasopara (JMC)
description:
Jerusalem Marthoma Church Nallasopara is a Christian church in Nallasopara, a Mumbai suburb. It belongs to the ancient Malankara Mar Thoma Syrian Church, also referred to as the Mar Thoma Church, and it is in communion with the One Holy Catholic and Apostolic Church traditions. The church has its origins in St. Thomas the Apostle (Mar Thoma), who is said to have introduced Christianity to India in AD 52, founding the church along the Malabar Coast (Kerala, formerly Malankara). Strongly grounded in Biblical principles, the church maintains its Episcopal tradition and practices a value-based democratic governance.

Vicar: Rev. Shinoy Thomas

featured_reviews.name: Jude D'lima
featured_reviews.review_text: Bethel Community Church has an warm air of acceptance, love , friendship and loads of family bonding. Group of people who love God passionately and depend upon Him for everything. Upholding God as Sovereign and priority of our lives. Don't miss an opportunity to taste God's divine powers on this planet 🌎 ... many Blessings!!!

featured_reviews.name: Pallavi Bhattacharya
featured_reviews.review_text: I was undergoing a very challenging situation in life in 2011. My train friend, who knew of this church, suggested that I drop in. Preaching by pastor and his wife helped me to overcome the agony of my heart and soul. I’d been to churches before, but this was the best. This is because pastor and his wife are truly in the Lord and give each and every believer personal attention. Certain churches had previously disappointed me as the pastors led lives very different from what they preached. In practical matters as well, the church has immensely helped me. There’s unity among the church goers. A wide range of topics are Biblically covered at church. The fill in the gaps method of various Biblical lessons, help us easily to remember and translate to our lives the content of what is taught.

featured_reviews.name: Laraine Dcosta
featured_reviews.review_text: Bethel church was like a cozy rest house on a lonely highway at a time when we were desperately searching for a good church. It's been 3 yrs now, and this church is  a family we're not only glad but blessed to be a part of.
